key_insight: AAbAAC is a manually annotated PubMed corpus for autoimmunity that helps specialized NER models better identify diseases, autoantibodies, targets, body locations, and clinical signs.
clinical_relevance: By improving extraction of autoimmunity concepts from text, the corpus can support biomedical knowledge discovery and downstream research in autoimmune disease understanding.
method: Evaluated several NER methods and fine-tuned NER models
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that NER performance improved after fine-tuning on AAbAAC, showing the value of the annotated dataset for this specialized domain.
watch_item: The corpus is small and domain-specific, so results may not generalize well beyond autoimmunity or beyond the annotated abstract-level text.
paper_title: AAbAAC: An Annotated Corpus for Autoimmunity Information Extraction
